sermon.title: Children in Four Approaches 09/09/2018
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer teaches that natural parents are responsible for their children, that fathers must nurture and instruct, and that the Bible gives four disciplines: spank, restrain, instruct and rebuke. He then shows that 1 Timothy 3’s qualifications for church leaders begin in the home, with honesty, self-control and example.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Statistics such as the Christian divorce rate and alcohol figures are kept as spoken and were not checked.
